index.title: Invoices
index.subtitle: What the dispatch company bills each carrier for its dispatch fee.

create.carrierHint: Only carriers with delivered loads that are not on a live invoice.
create.nothingToBill: This carrier has nothing to bill right now.

show.voidHint: An invoice that went out exists even if it was wrong. It is voided with a reason, and a new one is issued.
show.voidedWithPayment: A payment of {amount} was received against this invoice after it was voided. The invoice owes nothing — that money is probably owed back to the carrier.

status.voidedWithPayment: A payment of {amount} was received against this invoice after it was voided. The invoice owes nothing — that money is probably owed back to the carrier.

flash.created: Invoice {number} was created as a draft.
flash.sent: The invoice was marked as sent.
flash.voidedWithPayment: A payment of {amount} was received against this invoice after it was voided. The invoice owes nothing — that money is probably owed back to the carrier.
flash.notEmailed: The invoice is issued, but the email did not go out. The link exists: send it by hand.
flash.noRecipient: The invoice is issued. This carrier has no contact email, so it could not be sent.

errors.nothingToBill: None of those loads can be billed: they are not delivered, belong to another carrier, or are already on a live invoice.
errors.onlyDraftCanBeSent: Only a draft can be sent.
errors.cannotPayThis: A draft or a voided invoice cannot take a payment.
errors.overpaid: That is more than the outstanding balance.
errors.cannotVoidPaid: An invoice with a payment on it cannot be voided.

mockPay.title: Test payment
mockPay.body: Here you simulate what happens if the payment is accepted and if it is declined — the second path is the one almost nobody tries and the one that hurts most.
